about: TERMS-AUDIT-1. Read by tools/Test-SimplifiedEnglish.ps1. bannedPhrases: a word this product invented where Azure or the product already has one (CLAUDE.md rule 10). phrasalVerbs: a verb and a particle that together mean something neither word says; ASD-STE100 uses one approved verb with one meaning instead. Each entry has a pattern (a .NET regular expression, matched without case), the words to write instead, the source of the rule, sentences it must catch (examples) and sentences it must leave alone (allowed). SimplifiedEnglish.Tests.ps1 runs every example and every allowed sentence through the tool.

notBanned.why: Azure's and the product's word: Rolled back is a state on the Migrations page.
The button Leave this machine out.
Windows' and Linux's own words for the operating system stop.
The product's words for accelerated networking on the targets step and in the sign-off.

pendingAbout: MANUAL-REVIEW-1: findings of a term rule in a source that another open branch of the same review rewrites. source is the name -ListSources gives; idPrefix narrows engine-strings to one file; pattern is the rule's pattern, exactly. The tool reports each as waived, and SimplifiedEnglish.Tests.ps1 fails an entry that waives nothing, so the owner removes it with the fix.

bannedPhrases.use: 'rollback disk' for a disk made from the first safety copy; 'rollback', or 'a rollback or a restore', for the act
bannedPhrases.source: RENAME-WAY-BACK-1 (2026-11-12): the disks are rollback disks; the way back is not their name.
examples: The product could not make the disks for the way back.
Safety copies and the way back
Every machine has a way back.
allowed: The product could not make the rollback disks.
Safety copies and rollback
The product can roll back every machine.

bannedPhrases.use: 'no capacity reservation' (Azure has on-demand capacity reservations, and a machine has one or has none)
bannedPhrases.source: TERMS-AUDIT-1 (2026-11-04): Azure has no general capacity; name the quota or the capacity reservation.
examples: Capacity: placed on general capacity.
These machines move on general capacity.
General capacity
allowed: No on-demand capacity reservation. Its wave does not reserve capacity.
The general settings of the wave do not change.

bannedPhrases.source: TERMS-AUDIT-1 (2026-11-04), on the activity line 'Checking the network is running on accelerated hardware'.
examples: Checking the network is running on accelerated hardware
allowed: Checking that accelerated networking is in use

bannedPhrases.use: 'the new size', or 'NVMe' for the disk controller
bannedPhrases.source: TERMS-AUDIT-1 (lab Session A, 2026-11-04): the size and the disk controller have Azure names.
examples: The machine starts on the new hardware.
Preparing the operating system for the new disk hardware
It is returned to its original hardware.
allowed: The machine starts on its new size.
Preparing the operating system for NVMe

bannedPhrases.use: 'the product', the noun every other string uses for it (or its name, Migration Factory)
bannedPhrases.source: TERMS-AUDIT-1 (lab Session A, 2026-11-04): 'The tool stopped' names nothing the product calls itself. The strings say 'the product' more than 800 times, and the stop texts name 'the product's managed identity' (STOP-TEXT-SPECIFIC-1).
examples: The tool stopped the machine.
Do nothing. The tool moves the page file.
allowed: The product stopped the machine.
Migration Factory stopped the machine.
Install the tools on this page.

bannedPhrases.use: 'on-demand capacity reservation', Azure's name. A capacity reservation group and a capacity reservation are Azure's resource names. Azure Reservations is another Azure service.
bannedPhrases.source: MANUAL-REVIEW-1 catch list (2026-11-12): on-demand capacity reservation, never reservation alone. The exceptions name Azure Reservations, the other Azure service, and the sentence with a reservation for the old size (approved 2026-11-13).
except: a reservation for the old size
examples: A reservation holds capacity for the wave.
The reservation group is made in the resource group of the machines.
Quota and reservations are settled when the migration is planned.
allowed: An on-demand capacity reservation holds capacity for the wave.
The capacity reservation group is made in the resource group of the machines.
Azure Reservations and savings plans do not follow the machine.
An Azure Reservation covers only the sizes of its own instance size flexibility group, so a reservation for the old size does not cover the new size.

bannedPhrases.use: the fact for every install, with no lab, test run, region or resource group of the lab. Write <region> or <resource group> for a value that is yours.
bannedPhrases.source: MANUAL-REVIEW-1 catch list (2026-11-12): no lab numbers, lab dates or regions in shipped docs ("the lab used ...", "Central US").
examples: The lab used Central US.
Open rg-vmf-lab in the portal.
The engine ran in centralus and westus3.
No lab run has moved such a machine.
The drill measured it.
allowed: Open the resource group of the install in the portal.
The engine runs in the region of the install.
Select the label on the page.

bannedPhrases.use: 'the product'. 'Outside the scope of this tool' stays: those are the approved words for a scope statement.
bannedPhrases.source: TERMS-AUDIT-1 (lab Session A, 2026-11-04): 'This tool cannot see' names no product.
examples: This tool cannot see the role assignments.
allowed: A cluster node is outside the scope of this tool.
